race.comment: OLE DAZE (2) is the top pick on the strength of last campaign's Sandown-Lakeside second in BM66 grade, when beaten half a length, and he has a solid 1200m profile with one win and one placing from three attempts. His final run before the spell was plain after racing wide, but the Hayes stable has him resuming off mixed Pakenham trials and the 2kg claim helps. OCEANELLA (10) brings the best current race form, having won at Mornington two back before missing by only half a length at Cranbourne, and Teo Nugent's record on her helps. STOLEN ART (4) has been around the mark all campaign, draws barrier 1 and handles wet ground, though he has to turn placings into a win. CHERRY HILLS (9) resumes with Damian Lane on after a Pakenham Synthetic trial win, and her debut victory at Bendigo keeps her in the winning mix if she returns sharper than her last run before a spell.
